## 2. DEPOSIT AND UPFRONT PAYMENT

2.1 **Initial Deposit**: Client shall pay a non-refundable deposit of {{deposit_amount}} ({{deposit_percent}}% of total engagement value) upon execution of this Agreement.

2.2 **Purpose**: The deposit covers initial project setup, resource allocation, and commitment of Provider's team.

2.3 **Application**: The deposit will be applied to the first milestone payment(s).

## 3. MILESTONE PAYMENTS

3.1 **Payment Schedule**: Payments are tied to the following milestones:

| Milestone | Description | Deliverables | Amount | Due Date |
|-----------|-------------|--------------|--------|----------|
{{milestone_payment_table}}

3.2 **Invoice Process**:
- Provider will submit invoice upon milestone completion
- Invoice must include description of completed work and deliverables
- Client has {{acceptance_period_days}} days to review and accept/reject deliverables
- Payment due {{net_days}} days from invoice date

3.3 **Acceptance**: Milestones are deemed accepted if Client does not provide written rejection with specific deficiencies within the acceptance period.

## 6. EXPENSES

6.1 **Reimbursable Expenses**: Client shall reimburse Provider for reasonable, pre-approved expenses including:
- Travel and accommodation (if required)
- Third-party software licenses required for the project
- Cloud infrastructure and hosting costs
- Other pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses

6.2 **Expense Approval**: Expenses over {{expense_approval_threshold}} require Client's prior written approval.

6.3 **Documentation**: Provider will submit expense reports with supporting receipts and documentation.

## 8. LATE PAYMENT

8.1 **Late Fee**: Payments not received within {{net_days}} days of invoice date are subject to a late fee of {{late_fee_percent}}% per month ({{late_fee_daily_rate}}% per day).

8.2 **Suspension of Services**: If payment is more than {{suspension_threshold_days}} days overdue, Provider may suspend services until payment is received.

8.3 **Collection Costs**: Client shall pay all costs of collection, including reasonable attorney's fees, if Provider must pursue collection.

## 9. DISPUTED INVOICES

9.1 **Dispute Process**: If Client disputes any invoice, Client must:
- Pay the undisputed portion by the due date
- Notify Provider in writing of the specific disputed items within {{dispute_notice_days}} days
- Provide detailed explanation of the dispute

9.2 **Resolution**: The Parties will work in good faith to resolve disputes within {{dispute_resolution_days}} days.

## 10. TAXES

10.1 **Sales Tax**: All fees are exclusive of applicable sales tax, use tax, VAT, or other similar taxes, which Client shall pay or provide valid exemption certificate.

10.2 **Withholding**: If Client is required to withhold taxes, Client shall gross up payment to ensure Provider receives the full contracted amount.

## 11. CURRENCY

All amounts are in {{currency}} unless otherwise specified.

## 12. BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS

12.1 **Change Orders**: Any changes to scope that affect budget require a written Change Order signed by both Parties.

12.2 **Budget Overruns**: Provider will notify Client if project is at risk of exceeding budget and propose remediation options.

## 13. REFUND POLICY

13.1 **Deposit**: The initial deposit is non-refundable.

13.2 **Milestone Payments**: Payments for accepted milestones are non-refundable.

13.3 **Termination**: Upon termination, Client shall pay for:
- All completed and accepted milestones
- Work-in-progress on a pro-rata basis
- Any accrued but unpaid expenses
